title: Series
description: Data schema for a thematic Series branch within a Weapon Type in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

weaponTypeId.description: Identifier of the parent Weapon Type this series belongs to.

name.description: Display name of the series (e.g., 'Beast Series', 'Dwemer Series').

description.description: Lore and summary description of the series theme.

iconAsset.description: Path to visual theme/series icon asset for UI display.

rootNodeId.description: Optional starting node ID for this series progression tree branch.
